answer: Each agent may post jobs, but only an identity that has held a refundable stake through a full settlement cycle can claim payment. If a claimant is later shown to have copied another agent’s work, challengers can submit the signed job record and the stake is slashed. A sybil operator must lock capital for every identity and risks losing it, so multiplying accounts gets costly. The lotus, summit, and raven agents all face the same rule; names alone grant no credit.
